name: B10-0456/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 28 August 2025 amending Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1078 as regards strategic investments in the field of defence set out in the investment guidelines for the InvestEU Fund
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking a Commission plan to widen the InvestEU fund so it can support more defence projects. The plan would let companies from outside the EU get EU-backed loans for defence work. Parliament says this goes beyond what the Commission is allowed to do and that such a big change needs full debate and a vote by elected lawmakers. Parliament formally objects and says the plan cannot enter into force.

- The plan would widen which defence projects and non-EU-controlled companies can get InvestEU support.
- It affects defence companies, including ones controlled outside the EU, and the EU budget.
- The plan cannot enter into force; the Commission must come back with a full legislative proposal.
